## Audit contract

- Append chronologically from import through setup, preflight, launch, discovery, research, admission, card persistence, UI projection, and terminal reconciliation.
- Capture the exact visible provider prompts and visible model responses, selected role/model/capability, tool arguments and results, query text, source URLs, relevant public professional contact facts, timestamps, failure classifications, retries, and operator analysis when the application exposes them.
- Hidden model chain-of-thought is not exposed or reconstructed. Preserve model-produced action rationales only when they are an explicit visible output. Never claim that audit output contains private reasoning.
- Never record API key values, authorization headers/cookies, session tokens, or unrelated private personal details. Include public professional contact data only with source attribution and verification status.
- Treat tool errors, blocked calls, search leads, fetched pages, findings, admissions, and cards as distinct states. A card is successful only after durable persistence and the UI projection are reconciled.
- Do not report an Investigator key as exhausted unless the runtime emits a typed quota-exhaustion signal. Do not rotate credentials manually or replace the model-led architecture with fixed search steps.
- This is the current run's audit. Do not overwrite or conflate it with historical same-product audit files.
